detail:
New decision "`contested` is an annotation (history and explain packets), never a member of the current applicable view and never a change to the target's conflict state; oracle event counts are evaluated over the case's own record types only (principal/membership/observation/receipt excluded); C14 runs two arms (exchange-ref carrier and source-branch mode); `representations[]` lives on the admission-log projection, not the envelope; the admission log records a reason for every outcome; closed uncertainty windows are retained; attachment default 256 KiB" relates to:
- 01M2KCPDJK8K5QNHS047XWNQDX: "The foundational change (immutable event log + derived projections) is now JUSTIFIED by evidence, not hypothesis: the strongest one-release evolution of the current per-record export + file-wins design fails C10, C11, C14, C16, C22 and R05/R08 because the record file is simultaneously current state, history and merge unit, so git merge decides authority before Twining sees the bytes; the ADR stays PROPOSED until the vertical slice passes its independent oracles"
- 01M2KDRBYZP7GAXCM0ZX2E66MQ: "Added a `reinstated` lifecycle kind (target, reason; requires `rule` capability; class-ranked against the SUPERSEDING event's class) as the only path by which a superseded or overridden record becomes applicable again; `restored` (from archive) keeps ADR §4.4 semantics and never implies `promoted`"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 2 existing decision(s) overlap
